summary: Kapa Learning MVP tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 13 backend pytest tests passed (100%). Every frontend flow works: Home (SLA/location/search/3 banners/8-cat grid/6 bestsellers), category preselection from Home into Categories rail, rail switching (Registers -> Pens shows 12 products), +ADD -> quantity stepper morph with increment/decrement/back-to-ADD, floating cart tray with count + total, checkout with delivery instruction & tip chips, mock payment modal (UPI/Card/COD), and Live Order Tracking with 4-stage progress + rider info. All 4 bottom tabs (Home, Categories, Print Store, Profile) navigate cleanly. Profile screen lists prior guest orders. No deprecated expo packages, no red-screen errors. Only minor console warnings and a small product-card price wrapping issue.

ui_bugs.issue: On Categories product grid, price and MRP text can wrap character-by-character (e.g. '₹1 8 9' stacked vertically) when the ADD/stepper takes horizontal space in the narrow 75% column. Needs numberOfLines={1} + flexShrink on price and a min-width on the ADD area, or move price above CTA.

issues: Product card price row wraps under narrow width (rail eats 25%). Consider stacking price above the ADD button in the categories column layout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (RN 0.76+ / Reanimated Web). Reference: check styles in /app/frontend/src/components/* and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents={...} to style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}. Reference: search codebase for pointerEvents=.

Reanimated warning: 'Reading from `value` during component render' - a shared value is being read directly in render (should be inside useAnimatedStyle/useDerivedValue or via .get() on the UI thread only). Likely origin: /app/frontend/src/components/QuantityStepper.tsx (qtyStyle) or FloatingCart animation. Please audit useSharedValue usage.

action_items: Fix price-row wrapping in ProductCard when rendered inside the 75% Categories grid (numberOfLines=1 + flexShrink, or restructure card).
Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow across StyleSheets (FloatingCart, ProductCard, checkout, tracking).
Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents wherever used.
Audit Reanimated shared value usage - do not read .value during React render; use useAnimatedStyle/useDerivedValue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_order uses payload.totalAmount directly to compute deliveryCharge - a malicious client can under/over-report totalAmount. Consider server-side recalculation from items + tip + handling.
server.py: create_order stores order_doc via insert_one(copy()) then pops _id from the original - fine, but simpler to pass {"$set": ...} or explicitly exclude _id in a projection when reading back.
server.py: single file has models + seed + routes ~360 lines - still OK but nearing the threshold; consider splitting seed + routers if it grows.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers.
server.py: Pydantic v1 style .dict() calls (payload.items -> item.dict(), payload.deliveryAddress.dict()) - if Pydantic v2 is installed these emit DeprecationWarnings; prefer .model_dump().
All backend endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection - good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly and all interactive elements carry testID - good.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Backend auto-seeded 8 categories, 1 dark store, 38 products on startup. Two guest orders were created during the pytest run + a third via the UI checkout flow (all under userId='guest'). These persist in Mongo but do not interfere with re-runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Use /api/v1/* prefix. Guest userId='guest'. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kapa_api.py. All flows are Home -> ADD -> Floating Cart -> Checkout -> Payment (UPI/CARD/COD) -> Tracking. Tracking stage advancement is time-based (elapsed vs slaMinutes/4); on a fresh order only stage 0 will be marked completed.
rca_of_issue: N/A - MVP passed. Only cosmetic RN deprecation warnings and one product card wrapping issue reported for the main agent to polish.
